About Us

A little paradise
in Batumi

La Première Go Free was born from a simple idea — everyone deserves a moment of pure, carefree joy. We set up our little kitchen on Nodar Dumbadze Street and began crafting desserts that make people smile.

From our signature Belgian waffles to the go free chocolate sticks, everything is handmade fresh, every single day.
